duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 11/113, Muslim 4/2083

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. SubhanAllahi, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'adheem. Rabbighfir lee
duas.english: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest and there is no power and might except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. My Lord, forgive me.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/154

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee 'afanee fee jasadee, wa radda 'alayya roohee, wa athina lee bithikrih
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who gave strength to my body, returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/473

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ، اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ، إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabba Jibra'eela wa Mika'eela wa Israafeela, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon, ihdinee limakhtulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdee man tashaa'u ila siratim mustaqeem
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of Jibra'eel, Mika'eel and Israafeel, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen — You judge between Your slaves regarding what they used to differ in. Guide me to the truth wherein they differed by Your leave. Verily You guide whomever You will to a straight path.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 770. Recited when standing for night prayer after waking.

duas.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
duas.transliteration: Inna fee khalqis-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la-aayatin li-ulil-albab
duas.english: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. (Recite the last 10 verses of Surah Al-'Imran upon waking, as the Prophet ﷺ used to.)
duas.reference: Quran 3:190. Sahih Bukhari 4569 — the Prophet ﷺ recited the last 10 verses of Surah Al-'Imran upon waking for night prayer.

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
duas.english: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/317

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namootu, wa ilaykan-nushoor
duas.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/466

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'oothu bika min sharri ma sana't, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiru-th-thunooba illa ant
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your slave. I keep Your covenant and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sins except You.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/150

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
duas.transliteration: A'oothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem. Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom... (Ayat al-Kursi)
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaitan. Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence... (Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Baqarah 2:255)
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86. Recite once each morning and evening.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi
duas.english: Glory be to Allah and I praise Him.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2071. Recite 100 times each morning and evening.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
duas.english: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2071. Recite 10 times each morning.

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
duas.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/317

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namootu, wa ilaykal-maseer
duas.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening, and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and we die and unto You is our return.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/466

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee amsaytu ush-hiduk, wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikatak, wa jamee'a khalqik, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasooluk
duas.english: O Allah, I take You as a witness this evening, and I take the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation as witnesses, that You are Allah, there is no deity worthy of worship except You alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/317. Recite 4 times.

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amootu wa ahya
duas.english: In Your name O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 11/113, Muslim 4/2083

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qinee 'athabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your slaves.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/311. Recite 3 times.

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Bismika rabbee wada'tu janbee, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfadha bima tahfadhu bihi 'ibaadakas-saliheen
duas.english: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 11/126, Muslim 4/2084

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wa fawwadtu amree ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa alja'tu dhahree ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, aamantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wa binabiyyikal-lathee arsalt
duas.english: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 11/113, Muslim 4/2081

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma rabbana wa bihamdik, allahummaghfir lee
duas.english: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 8/168, Muslim 4/2173

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: A'oothu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi, wa sharri 'ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayateeni wa an yahdurun
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the whispered insinuations of the devils and from their presence.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3893, At-Tirmidhi 3528 (Sahih). Recited before sleep.

duas.arabic: اللهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, la ta'khuthuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard... (Ayat al-Kursi)
duas.english: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep... (Recite Ayat al-Kursi, Quran 2:255, before sleeping.)
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 2311 — 'Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi when going to bed, Allah will appoint a guardian over him and no devil will come near him until morning.'

duas.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ...
duas.transliteration: Tabarakal-lathee biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer... (Surah Al-Mulk)
duas.english: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is over all things competent... (Recite Surah Al-Mulk before sleeping.)
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 2891 (Hasan) — 'There is a surah in the Qur'an of thirty verses that interceded for a man until he was forgiven, and it is Tabarakalladhee biyadihil-mulk.'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ba'id baynee wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, allahumma naqqinee minal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummaghsil khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad
duas.english: O Allah, separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow, and hail.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/181, Muslim 1/419. Opening supplication in prayer.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wa 'afinee, warzuqnee
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1/220. Said between the two prostrations.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee dhalamtu nafsee dhulman katheeran wa la yaghfirudh-thunooba illa ant, faghfir lee maghfiratan min 'indak, warhamnee innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem
duas.english: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So, grant me forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely, you are Forgiving, Merciful.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 8/168, Muslim 4/2078. Said in the final tashahhud.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3/347. Say before eating.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi fee awwalihi wa aakhirih
duas.english: In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3/347. If you forget to say Bismillah at the start, say this when you remember.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amanee hatha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa la quwwah
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who has given me this food and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/510. Said after eating.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana feehi wa at'imna khayran minh
duas.english: O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 4/283. Said when given milk to drink.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma at'im man at'amanee, wasqi man saqanee
duas.english: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
duas.reference: Muslim 3/126

duas.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Subhanalladhee sakhkhara lana hatha wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fee safarina hathal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hatha watwi 'anna bu'dah
duas.english: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our return. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey, and for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover its distance quickly.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/978

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-mandhar, wa soo'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of heart and from being in a bad predicament, and I seek refuge with You from an ill-fated outcome with wealth and family.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 2/657, Muslim 2/978

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khaleefatu fil-ahl
duas.english: O Allah, You are the Companion during travel and the Guardian of the family.
duas.reference: Muslim 2/978

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka khayra hathihil-qaryati wa khayra ahlihaa, wa a'oothu bika min sharrihaa wa sharri ahliha wa sharri ma feehaa
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this town and the goodness of its people, and I seek refuge with You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil found within it.
duas.reference: Al-Hakim 2/100. Said when entering a town.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaaka innee kuntu minadh-dhalimeen
duas.english: There is no deity worthy of worship except You. How perfect You are. Verily I was among the wrongdoers.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Dua of Prophet Yunus (AS).

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih lee sha'nee kullahu, la ilaha illa ant
duas.english: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye, and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/324

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'adheemul-haleem, la ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'adheem, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawaati wa rabbul-ardhi wa rabbul-'arshil-kareem
duas.english: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, the All-Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 8/154, Muslim 4/2092

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee 'abduk, ibnu 'abdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qada'uk
duas.english: O Allah, I am Your slave, son of Your slave, son of Your female slave, my forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just.
duas.reference: Ahmad 1/391. Part of the dua for removing worry and sorrow.

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakeel
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the Best Disposer of affairs.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 5/172. (Quran 3:173)

duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa la takilnee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 3524 (Hasan per Al-Albani). Said by the Prophet ﷺ when something distressed him.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika min jahdil-balaa', wa darakish-shaqaa', wa soo'il-qadaa', wa shamatatil-a'daa'
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe trials, from being overtaken by misery, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 6347, Sahih Muslim 2707

duas.arabic: فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Faatiras-samawati wal-ardi, anta waliyyee fid-dunya wal-aakhirah, tawaffanee musliman wa alhiqnee bi-saaliheen
duas.english: Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
duas.reference: Quran 12:101. Dua of Prophet Yusuf (AS).

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي، أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika aamantu, wa 'alayka tawakkaltu, wa ilayka anabtu, wa bika khasamt. A'oothu bi'izzatika la ilaha illa anta an tudillanee — antal-Hayyul-lathee la yamoot, wal-jinnu wal-insu yamootoon
duas.english: O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I rely, to You I turn, and through You I dispute. I seek refuge in Your might — there is no deity worthy of worship except You — that You should not lead me astray. You are the Ever-Living who does not die, while the jinn and mankind die.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 7383, Sahih Muslim 2717

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-jubn, wa a'oothu bika an uradda ila ardhalil-'umur, wa a'oothu bika min fitnatid-dunya, wa a'oothu bika min 'athabil-qabr
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, from being returned to a most decrepit old age, from the trials of this world, and from the punishment of the grave.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 6365

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullahala-'atheema allathee la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayh
duas.english: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty, whom there is no deity worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence, and I repent to Him.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/85, At-Tirmidhi 5/569

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86. Said 100 times.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lee thanbee kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa aakhirah, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrah
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.
duas.reference: Muslim 1/350

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana dhalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.reference: Quran 7:23. The dua of Adam (AS) and Hawwa (AS).

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana faghfir lana thunoobana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abraar
duas.english: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.
duas.reference: Quran 3:193

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-raahimeen
duas.english: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of those who show mercy.
duas.reference: Quran 23:118

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي كُلِّهِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جِدِّي وَهَزْلِي، وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir lee khatee'atee wa jahlee, wa israafee fee amree kullihi, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minnee. Allahumma-ghfir lee jiddee wa hazlee, wa khata'ee wa 'amdee, wa kullu thalika 'indee
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me my errors, my ignorance, my excess in my affairs, and what You know better about me than I do myself. O Allah, forgive me my seriousness and my jest, my mistakes and my deliberateness — and all of that is from me.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 6398, Sahih Muslim 2719

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'oothu billahil-'adheem, wa biwajhihil-kareem, wa sultanihil-qadeem, minash-shaytanir-rajeem
duas.english: I seek refuge with Allah the Almighty and with His Noble Face, and His eternal power, from the accursed devil.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1/126. Said upon entering the mosque.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah, allahummaghfir lee thunoobi waftah lee abwaba rahmatik
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open to me the doors of Your mercy.
duas.reference: Muslim 1/494. Said upon entering the mosque.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah, allahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.
duas.reference: Muslim 1/494. Said upon leaving the mosque.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-lathee la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
duas.english: In the name of Allah with Whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/323. Recite 3 times morning and evening for protection.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'oothu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.reference: Muslim 4/2080. Recite 3 times in the evening.

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: A'oothu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature and from every evil eye.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 4/119. Said over children as protection.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by other people.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/158

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 5095, At-Tirmidhi 3426 (Sahih). Said upon leaving the home — the Prophet ﷺ said: 'You will be guided, sufficed, and protected; the devils withdraw from you.'

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala-llahi rabbina tawakkalna
duas.english: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 5096 (Hasan). Said upon entering the home; then greet your family with salam.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw adhlima aw udhlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayy
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be caused to slip, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 5094, At-Tirmidhi 3427 (Sahih). Said upon leaving the home.

duas.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۞ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad / Qul a'oothu birabbil-falaq / Qul a'oothu birabbin-naas (Surahs 112, 113, 114 — Mu'awwidhat)
duas.english: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas — three times each, morning and evening, for protection.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 5082, At-Tirmidhi 3575 (Sahih). 'They will suffice you against everything.'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika min sharri sam'ee, wa min sharri basaree, wa min sharri lisaanee, wa min sharri qalbee, wa min sharri maniyyee
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing, the evil of my sight, the evil of my tongue, the evil of my heart, and the evil of my desire.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1551, At-Tirmidhi 3492 (Hasan)

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa liman dakhala baytee mu'minan wa lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minat
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and believing women.
duas.reference: Quran 71:28

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
duas.reference: Quran 17:24

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa thurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imama
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
duas.reference: Quran 25:74

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
duas.english: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/206. Said when it rains.

duas.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Mutirna bifadlillahi wa rahmatih
duas.english: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/205, Muslim 1/83. Said after it rains.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hawalayyna wa la 'alayna, allahumma 'alal-akam wadh-dhirab, wa butoonil-awdiyah, wa manabitis-shajar
duas.english: O Allah, let it pass and not fall on us. O Allah, let it fall on the hills and mountains, the valleys and the roots of trees.
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari 1/224. Said during heavy rain.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilma
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.reference: Quran 20:114

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumman-fa'nee bima 'allamtanee, wa 'allimnee ma yanfa'unee, wa zidnee 'ilma
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/742

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision and acceptable deeds.
duas.reference: Ibn Majah 1/152. Said after Fajr prayer.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'innee 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to worship You in the best manner.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1522, An-Nasa'i 1303 (Sahih). Said after every prayer — taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA).

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear (You), from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 2722

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْنِي فِي الدِّينِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma faqqih-nee fid-deen
duas.english: O Allah, grant me understanding of the religion. (The Prophet ﷺ supplicated 'Allahumma faqqih-hu fid-deen' for Ibn 'Abbas (RA).)
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 75, Sahih Muslim 2477

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah lee sadree, wa yassir lee amree, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisaanee, yafqahoo qawlee
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
duas.reference: Quran 20:25-28. Dua of Prophet Musa (AS) — said before studying, teaching, or any matter requiring clarity.

duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.transliteration: As'alullaha-l-'Adheema rabbal-'arshil-'adheem an yashfiyak
duas.english: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3106, At-Tirmidhi 2083 (Sahih). Recited 7 times when visiting the sick.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ ﴿ثَلَاثًا﴾، أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ ﴿سَبْعًا﴾
duas.transliteration: Bismillah (3 times), then: A'oothu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhaadhir (7 times)
duas.english: In the name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge in Allah and in His power from the evil of what I find and what I fear (7 times).
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 2202. Place hand on the painful area, say Bismillah 3 times, then the rest 7 times.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-naas, adh-hibil-ba's, ishfi antash-Shaafee, la shifaa'a illa shifaa'uk, shifaa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove this affliction. Cure, for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure — a cure that leaves behind no illness.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 5675, Sahih Muslim 2191

duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba's, tahoorun inshaa-Allah
duas.english: Do not worry — it (this illness) will be a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 5662. Said when visiting the sick to comfort them.

duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Annee massaniya-d-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimeen
duas.english: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
duas.reference: Quran 21:83. Dua of Prophet Ayyub (AS) during his trial of illness.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-barasi, wal-junooni, wal-judhaami, wa min sayyi'il-asqaam
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, insanity, elephantiasis, and from evil diseases.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1554, An-Nasa'i 5493 (Sahih)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fid-dunya wal-aakhirah
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.reference: Sunan Abu Dawud 5074 (Sahih). Among the most beloved supplications of the Prophet ﷺ — said morning and evening.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, allahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, allahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant
duas.english: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no deity worthy of worship except You.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 5090 (Sahih). Said morning and evening — 3 times each.

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakuma fee khayr
duas.english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you both in goodness.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2130, At-Tirmidhi 1091 (Sahih). Said to congratulate the newlyweds.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, allahumma jannibna-sh-shaytan, wa jannibi-sh-shaytana ma razaqtana
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You have provided us.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 6388, Sahih Muslim 1434. Said by spouses before intimacy.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma jabaltaha 'alayh, wa a'oothu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha 'alayh
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the goodness with which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil with which You have created her.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2160, Ibn Majah 1918 (Hasan). Said upon marrying — placing the hand on the wife's forelock.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً، إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka samee'u-d-du'aa'
duas.english: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
duas.reference: Quran 3:38. Dua of Prophet Zakariya (AS) for righteous offspring.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي، رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'alnee muqeemas-salati wa min dhurriyyatee, rabbana wa taqabbal du'aa'
duas.english: My Lord, make me a constant performer of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
duas.reference: Quran 14:40. Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS).

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mina-s-saaliheen
duas.english: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
duas.reference: Quran 37:100. Dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) for a righteous child.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-kfinee bihalalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bifadlika 'amman siwaak
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, [keeping me away] from what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others by Your bounty.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 3563 (Hasan). Taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Ali (RA) for relief from debt.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.reference: Quran 28:24. Dua of Prophet Musa (AS) when poor and exhausted.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْقِلَّةِ، وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-faqri, wal-qillati, wadh-dhillati, wa a'oothu bika min an adhlima aw udhlam
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation; and I seek refuge in You from oppressing or being oppressed.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1544, An-Nasa'i 5460 (Sahih)

duas.arabic: هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ
duas.transliteration: Haadha min fadli rabbee, liyabluwanee a-ashkuru am akfur
duas.english: This is from the favour of my Lord — to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful.
duas.reference: Quran 27:40. Said by Prophet Sulaiman (AS) upon seeing the throne brought to him.

duas.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ، وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ، بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Qul-illahumma maalikal-mulk, tu'til-mulka man tashaa', wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tashaa', wa tu'izzu man tashaa', wa tudhillu man tashaa', biyadikal-khayr, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
duas.english: Say: O Allah, Owner of all sovereignty. You give sovereignty to whom You will, and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honour whom You will, and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
duas.reference: Quran 3:26

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyee wa yumeet, wa huwa hayyun la yamoot, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
duas.english: There is no deity worthy of worship but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and gives death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.
duas.reference: At-Tirmidhi 3429, Ibn Majah 2235 (Hasan per Al-Albani). Said when entering the marketplace.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa rabbal-'arshil-'adheem, rabbana wa rabba kulli shay', iqdi 'annid-dayna wa aghninee minal-faqr
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of everything — settle my debt for me and free me from poverty.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 2713 (portion of the longer dua)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 1/494. Said upon leaving the mosque — asking Allah for His provision.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala aali Ibraheem, innaka hameedun majeed. Allahumma baarik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammad, kama baarakta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala aali Ibraheem, innaka hameedun majeed
duas.english: O Allah, send Your prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent Your prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
duas.reference: Sahih Bukhari 3370. Sending salawat is especially recommended on Friday.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad
duas.english: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 1047 (Sahih) — 'Send abundant salawat upon me on Friday, for it is a witnessed day attended by the angels.'

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaaba-n-naar
duas.english: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Quran 2:201. The most comprehensive du'a — recommended at the hour of acceptance on Friday (Sahih Bukhari 935, Sahih Muslim 852).

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
duas.reference: Quran 18:10. From Surah Al-Kahf — recited on Fridays per the Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ.
